rationale: Check round for the follow-up fix on the projects list page (ProjectsManagementFull.tsx), against a 4-line source fix-up diff plus one new regression test. The prior final verdict (code-review-final.json) carried no blocking findings, so finding_status is empty and there was nothing to re-verify; business_review and standards_review are carried forward unchanged per the check-round contract. A scoped confirmation pass (blind + edge-case lenses on the fix-up diff alone) was dispatched because the fix-up introduces production code the final round never saw. One suspected high-risk issue was raised and REFUTED: the blind lens posited that updatedProject could be undefined, making `updatedProject.name` throw inside the try block, diverting to catch and skipping projectDisplayNamesStore.invalidate + userStore.getCurrentUser. The edge-case lens refuted it against source — src/store/projects.ts:270-282 returns `{...result, id: result.name}`, always an object, never undefined; and src/utils/api.ts:369-379 rejects on non-2xx even with skipErrorHandling, so a failed update never reaches the toast. No crash path, no skipped cache invalidation. 2 findings deferred (non-blocking, recorded here rather than emitted): (1) `updatedProject.name` has no fallback, and the Promise<Project> contract is compile-time only (response.json() is `any`), so a malformed 2xx body omitting `name` would print 'Project undefined updated successfully'. Narrow, not security/public-API/data-loss/runtime correctness, and identical to the already-merged ProjectDetailsPage pattern; `?? editingProject.name` would close it. (2) The new regression test resolves the updateProject mock to `mockProject` — the same object as the row being edited — so it cannot distinguish `updatedProject.name` from `editingProject.name`. It is still a valid regression test for the reported defect: the edge-case lens verified it goes red when the fix is reverted ('Project updated successfully' fails the exact-string assertion). Resolving the mock to a distinct name would make it prove the value comes from the server response. 3 dismissed: blind lens's crash path (refuted above); blind lens's claim that the toast should show display_name (contradicts the spec AC, which explicitly requires the project name); projectDisplayNamesStore.invalidate key asymmetry on rename (pre-existing, declared out of scope in spec.md). Both new commit subjects match the EPMCDME-NNNNN: Capital sentence format required by git-workflow.md. No security, public API, or data contract surface is touched.
